reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: authMiddleware has 10 live call sites in src/index.ts (L68-77). Gate 2: attack entry point is unauthenticated public HTTP — no trusted data source in the path; BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json contains no trust_assumptions field. Gate 3: src/middleware/ is explicitly in scope and 'Bearer token authentication strength (timing-safe comparison)' is a named key_security_concern. An attacker can trigger this via the public HTTP API by sending statistically large volumes of requests to POST /api/roles/sync with varying token byte prefixes, measuring response latency differences to reconstruct API_AUTH_TOKEN byte-by-byte, causing full authentication bypass across all 10+ protected endpoints.
